verdict.rationale: dlt itself is a library that can run anywhere (Airflow, Lambda, containers) and dltHub offers 'dlthub deploy' with scheduling, backfill, and chaining of pipelines, plus GitHub Actions guide for recurring runs; this shows scheduling is achievable but mostly via dltHub's separate managed product or external orchestrators rather than a built-in native scheduler in dlt core. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of dltHub's scheduling in production use, details on cron-like recurrence configuration, and confirmation this works fully standalone without relying on third-party orchestrators (Airflow/GitHub Actions).
